title: rosa canina subvar. mollardiana
intro: Rosa canina subvar. mollardiana, commonly known as the Wild Rose, is a shrub species within the Rosa canina species, characterized by its fragrant flowers and edible fruits. The health benefits of Rosa canina subvar. mollardiana include its use in treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting cardiovascular health, due to its rich content of antioxidants and essential vitamins. The plant's therapeutic actions include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina subvar. mollardiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
